2607.15240.title: TikStance: A Multimodal and Hierarchical Dataset for Multi-target Stance Analysis in TikTok Political Conversations
2607.15240.paper_summary: Political discourse has increasingly moved to short-video platforms, yet computational analysis of such content remains constrained by the scarcity of datasets that jointly preserve audiovisual information and hierarchical conversations. Here we present TikStance, a multimodal and context-aware dataset comprising 161 videos and 13,876 comments from TikTok, designed for stance detection in political discussions. The dataset covers three major political figures in the 2024 U.S. election cycle--Donald Trump, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris--with content collected between September 2023 and January 2025. Each discussion unit links a host video and its metadata to a parent-linked comment tree, enabling stance analysis within both audiovisual and conversational context. Each item was independently labeled by three annotators using a three-class scheme (Favor, Against, None) for video-to-target and comment-to-target stance; items with disagreement were re-annotated, and the final Krippendorff's \(α\) reached 0.743, 0.723, and 0.722 for the Trump, Biden, and Harris subsets, respectively. Descriptive analysis further reveals target-dependent differences in stance distributions and conversational depth, with nested replies accounting for 23.3\% of all comments. By combining multi-target coverage, hierarchical conversations, and reliable multi-level human annotations, TikStance supports research in multimodal stance detection, political communication, computational social science, and context-aware natural language processing.
2607.15240.paper_summary_zh: 政治話語越來越多地轉向短視頻平台，然而對此類內容的計算分析仍然受到缺乏同時保留視聽信息和層級對話的數據集的限制。在此，我們呈現 TikStance，一個多模態且具上下文感知的數據集，包含來自 TikTok 的 161 個視頻和 13,876 條評論，旨在進行政治討論中的立場檢測。該數據集涵蓋了 2024 年美國選舉周期中的三位主要政治人物——唐納德·特朗普、喬·拜登和卡馬拉·哈里斯——其內容收集時間介於 2023 年 9 月至 2025 年 1 月之間。每個討論單元將主視頻及其元數據與父鏈接的評論樹相連，從而使得在視聽和對話上下文中進行立場分析成為可能。每個項目均由三位標註者獨立標註，使用三類方案（贊成、反對、無）對視頻與目標以及評論與目標的立場進行標註；對於存在分歧的項目進行了重新標註，最終的 Krippendorff's \(α\) 在特朗普、拜登和哈里斯子集中的分別達到 0.743、0.723 和 0.722。描述性分析進一步揭示了立場分佈和對話深度的目標依賴性差異，其中嵌套回覆佔所有評論的 23.3\%。通過結合多目標覆蓋、層級對話和可靠的多層次人類標註，TikStance 支持多模態立場檢測、政治傳播、計算社會科學和上下文感知自然語言處理的研究。
